$comment: Dev runner config for scripts/dev/qd. Paths are relative to the repo root. Ports = <devDigit>0<portSlot>0; slots are project-agnostic and match the edge routes: 1 app (dev.by-ali.dev), 2 sites (<site>.dev.by-ali.dev), 3 api (api.dev.by-ali.dev). Per-machine overrides live in .qubo/dev.local.json (gitignored).

web.$comment: Serves every site as <slug>.dev.by-ali.dev (PLATFORM_BASE_DOMAIN); `host` is the one qd probes and prints. --hostname localhost (not {bind}): Next dev builds proxy URLs as localhost:<port>, and host-based rewrites only stay internal when the bind hostname matches. localhost resolves to 127.0.0.1, so it stays loopback-only.

dataPlane.localHint: Start Docker, then `supabase start` (or `docker start supabase_db_react`).
